C028.name: Tanga City Council
C028.documented: coastal floods, large waves and strong winds, heavy Masika and Vuli rain, cholera, and boat accidents

area.en: Tanga City: coast, port and low-lying mitaa
area.sw: Jiji la Tanga: pwani, bandari na mitaa ya chini

risk.en: This area is a coastal port city where storm tides and erosion attack the shore, heavy rain floods low streets and the port and industries carry fire and spill risk.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni jiji la bandari la pwani ambapo mawimbi makubwa na mmomonyoko hushambulia ufukwe, mvua kubwa hufurika mitaa ya chini na bandari na viwanda vina hatari ya moto na kumwagika kwa kemikali.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to build back from the shoreline, keep drains open and keep fire extinguishers and exits ready at workplaces. What raises the risk: building on the beach front, cutting mangroves, mining sand from the shore, filling the drains with waste and blocking factory and port exits with stock. Know the higher ground inland that your household will move to when a storm-tide warning is given or the low streets flood, and the assembly point outside the workplace fence that workers will go to if fire or a chemical leak starts. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na ufukwe, kuweka mitaro wazi na kuweka vizimamoto na njia za kutokea tayari kazini. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ufukweni, kukata mikoko, kuchimba mchanga ufukweni, kujaza mitaro taka na kuziba njia za kutokea za viwanda na bandari kwa mizigo. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo kaya yako itahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba inapotolewa au mitaa ya chini inapofurika, na kituo cha kukusanyika nje ya uzio wa kazini ambacho wafanyakazi wataenda moto au uvujaji wa kemikali ukianza. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C031.name: Handeni Town Council
C031.documented: flash floods (about 29 deaths in the 2019 Handeni floods), heavy rain, and drought between seasons

area.en: Handeni Town: dry hills and town streams
area.sw: Mji wa Handeni: milima kame na vijito vya mji

risk.en: This area is a dry hill town where water is scarce in the dry season and storm run-off floods valley streets and cuts gullies.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa milima kame ambapo maji ni haba wakati wa kiangazi na maji ya dhoruba hufurika mitaa ya mabondeni na kuchimba makorongo.

advice.en: For those living here, it helps to harvest and store water safely, keep drains open and build away from gully edges. What raises the risk in both wet and dry months: building at the gully mouths or in the valley streets, filling the drains with waste, and leaving water standing in open containers after the rains. Know the higher street your household will move to when storm run-off rises in the valley, and agree early where water will come from when the town supply runs short. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi hapa, ni vyema kuvuna na kuhifadhi maji kwa usalama, kuweka mitaro wazi na kujenga mbali na kingo za makorongo. Kinachoongeza hatari katika miezi ya mvua na ya kiangazi: kujenga kwenye midomo ya makorongo au mitaa ya bondeni, kujaza mitaro taka, na kuacha maji yakituama kwenye vyombo wazi baada ya mvua. Fahamu mtaa wa juu ambao kaya yako itahamia maji ya dhoruba yanapopanda bondeni, na kubalianeni mapema maji yatatoka wapi maji ya mji yanapopungua. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C026.name: Korogwe Town Council
C026.documented: Pangani floods, heavy rain, and landslides on the Usambara edge

area.en: Korogwe Town: Pangani river and highway
area.sw: Mji wa Korogwe: mto Pangani na barabara kuu

risk.en: This area lies on the Pangani river and the Dar–Arusha highway, where the river floods low areas and heavy traffic brings accident risk.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko kando ya mto Pangani na barabara kuu ya Dar–Arusha, ambapo mto hufurika maeneo ya chini na magari mengi huleta hatari ya ajali.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep homes off the river banks and trade outside the road reserve. What raises the risk: building on the Pangani banks, trading or parking inside the highway reserve, and driving through flooded road sections. Know the higher ground away from the river that your household will move to when the Pangani rises, and go before the water reaches the road. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na kingo za mto na kufanya biashara nje ya hifadhi ya barabara. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga kwenye kingo za Pangani, kufanya biashara au kuegesha ndani ya hifadhi ya barabara kuu, na kupita kwa gari sehemu za barabara zilizofurika. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na mto ambalo kaya yako itahamia Pangani inapojaa, na ondokeni kabla maji hayajafika barabarani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C024.name: Bumbuli District Council
C024.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the Usambara Mountains, and valley floods

risk.en: This area has steep, densely farmed Usambara slopes where heavy rain causes landslides, rockfalls and washed-out roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina miteremko mikali ya Usambara inayolimwa kwa wingi ambapo mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko ya udongo na mawe na kusomba barabara.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep terraces and trees on slopes and build away from steep cuts, gullies and stream banks. What raises the risk: opening new fields on the steepest slopes, cutting into the slope behind a house, clearing the trees above it and building below gully mouths. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open above the houses, trees lean or water runs muddy during heavy rain. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutunza matuta na miti kwenye miteremko na kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali, makorongo na kingo za vijito. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba mapya kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba, kukata miti juu yake na kujenga chini ya midomo ya makorongo. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka juu ya nyumba, miti ikiinama au maji yakitiririka ya matope wakati wa mvua kubwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C030.name: Handeni District Council
C030.documented: flash floods, heavy rain, drought in the dry months, and strong winds

area.en: Handeni DC: dry plains and grazing land
area.sw: Handeni DC: tambarare kame na malisho

risk.en: This area has dry plains where droughts fail crops and pasture, flash floods cross roads and conflicts arise between farmers and herders.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina tambarare kame ambapo ukame huharibu mazao na malisho, mafuriko ya ghafla hupita barabarani na migogoro hutokea kati ya wakulima na wafugaji.

advice.en: For those farming and herding here, it helps to plant drought-tolerant crops, follow village land-use plans and never cross flowing water. What raises the loss and to the quarrels in a dry year: relying on maize alone, keeping more animals than the dry-season pasture can carry, driving herds onto cropped fields and crossing the drifts while water is running. Agree early, between farmers and herders, where the herds will water and the families will find food in a failed season, and move the animals before they weaken; on the road, wait for the water to drop. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame, kufuata mipango ya matumizi ya ardhi ya vijiji na kutovuka kamwe maji yanayotiririka. Kinachoongeza hasara na migogoro mwaka wa ukame: kutegemea mahindi pekee, kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko malisho ya kiangazi yanavyoweza kubeba, kuingiza mifugo kwenye mashamba yenye mazao na kuvuka vivuko maji yakitiririka. Kubalianeni mapema, wakulima na wafugaji, mifugo itanyweshwa wapi na familia zitapata wapi chakula msimu ukikosekana, na hamisheni mifugo kabla haijadhoofika; barabarani, subirini maji yapungue. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C032.name: Kilindi District Council
C032.documented: drought, strong winds, flash floods, and wildfire

area.en: Kilindi: remote dry farmland and grazing
area.sw: Kilindi: mashamba kame ya mbali na malisho

risk.en: This area is remote dry farmland where droughts and dry-season fires are common and rains cut roads to scattered villages.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mashamba kame ya mbali ambapo ukame na moto wa kiangazi ni wa kawaida na mvua hukata barabara za kwenda vijiji vilivyotawanyika.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep food and medicine reserves, burn only under control and keep fire breaks. What raises the risk: burning late in the dry season on windy days, leaving fires unattended, and letting village food and medicine stocks run out before the roads close. Know the cleared open ground your household will move to if a bush fire comes towards the houses, and restock before the rains, because the road may be cut for weeks. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuweka akiba ya chakula na dawa, kuchoma kwa udhibiti tu na kuweka njia za kuzuia moto. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchoma mwishoni mwa kiangazi siku za upepo, kuacha moto bila uangalizi, na kuacha akiba za chakula na dawa za kijiji ziishe kabla barabara hazijafungwa. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kaya yako itahamia moto wa porini ukielekea nyumbani, na jazeni akiba kabla ya mvua, kwa sababu barabara inaweza kufungwa kwa wiki. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C025.name: Korogwe District Council
C025.documented: Pangani floods, heavy rain, and landslides on the Usambara slopes

area.en: Korogwe DC: Pangani valley and Usambara foothills
area.sw: Korogwe DC: bonde la Pangani na vilima vya Usambara

risk.en: This area has the Pangani valley and sisal estates, where the river floods farms, and Usambara foothills where heavy rain causes landslides.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina bonde la Pangani na mashamba ya mkonge, ambapo mto hufurika mashamba, na vilima vya Usambara ambapo mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep homes above flood lines and away from steep slopes, and keep slopes planted. What raises the risk: building on the Pangani flood plain or at the foot of the cut slopes, clearing the foothill trees, and crossing the flooded drifts on foot or by motorcycle. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the Pangani spreads over the farms, and the firm ground off the slope you will go to when heavy rain sets in on the Usambaras; go when the river starts to rise, not after. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya mistari ya mafuriko na mbali na miteremko mikali, na kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga kwenye tambarare ya mafuriko ya Pangani au chini ya miteremko iliyochongwa, kukata miti ya vilima, na kuvuka vivuko vilivyofurika kwa miguu au pikipiki. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia Pangani inapotapakaa mashambani, na eneo imara nje ya mteremko mtakaloenda mvua kubwa inapoanza Usambara; ondokeni mto unapoanza kupanda, si baadaye. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C023.name: Lushoto District Council
C023.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the West Usambara, valley floods, and strong winds

risk.en: This area has very steep, crowded mountain slopes where heavy rain triggers deadly landslides and rockfalls and cuts the only roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina miteremko mikali sana yenye watu wengi ambapo mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko hatari ya udongo na mawe na kukata barabara pekee.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to build away from steep cuts and old slide scars, keep terraces and trees on slopes and report new cracks early. What raises the risk: cutting house plots into the steepest slopes, building on old slide scars because the ground looks settled, clearing the last trees above the villages and ignoring new cracks; for new building choose level ground away from the cut slopes, and for houses already here agree the way out and watch the cracks. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there the moment cracks open, trees lean, springs turn muddy or the ground rumbles during heavy rain, at night as well as by day; do not wait for the committee to arrive. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na makovu ya maporomoko ya zamani, kutunza matuta na miti kwenye miteremko na kutoa taarifa mapema za nyufa mpya. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kujenga kwenye makovu ya maporomoko ya zamani kwa sababu ardhi inaonekana imetulia, kukata miti ya mwisho juu ya vijiji na kupuuza nyufa mpya; kwa ujenzi mpya chagueni ardhi tambarare mbali na miinuko iliyochongwa, na kwa nyumba zilizopo tayari kubalianeni njia ya kutokea na fuatilieni nyufa. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko mara nyufa zikifunguka, miti ikiinama, chemchemi zikiwa za matope au ardhi ikinguruma wakati wa mvua kubwa, usiku na mchana; msisubiri kamati ifike. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C033.name: Mkinga District Council
C033.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.sw: Mkinga: pwani na mpaka wa Kenya

risk.en: This area has coastal villages exposed to erosion and storm tides, mangrove creeks and dry inland farmland near the Kenya border.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya pwani vinavyoathiriwa na mmomonyoko na mawimbi makubwa, hori za mikoko na mashamba kame ya ndani karibu na mpaka wa Kenya.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to build back from the shoreline, protect mangroves and stay ashore in strong winds. What raises the risk: building on the beach, cutting mangroves for poles or plots, mining sand from the shore and going out in loaded boats when the wind is rising. Know the higher ground inland that your village will move to when a storm-tide or strong-wind warning is given, and move before the tide, not during it. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na ufukwe, kulinda mikoko na kubaki ufukweni upepo mkali unapovuma. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ufukweni, kukata mikoko kwa ajili ya nguzo au viwanja, kuchimba mchanga ufukweni na kutoka baharini kwa vyombo vilivyojaa upepo unapopanda. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba au upepo mkali inapotolewa, na hamieni kabla ya maji kujaa, si wakati yanajaa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C027.name: Muheza District Council
C027.documented: heavy rain, landslides on the East Usambara, coastal floods, and strong winds

risk.en: This area has the East Usambara forests and slopes where heavy rain causes landslides, and farmland where streams flood crossings.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina misitu na miteremko ya Usambara Mashariki ambapo mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko, na mashamba ambapo vijito hufurika vivuko.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to protect forest cover, keep slopes planted and know flood-prone crossings. What raises the risk: clearing the forest on the slopes, opening fields on the steepest ground, building on the stream banks and crossing the flooded drifts on foot or by motorcycle. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open or water runs muddy; in the lowlands, know the higher ground your household will move to when the streams rise, and wait at the crossings rather than wade. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kulinda misitu, kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko na kujua vivuko vinavyofurika. Kinachoongeza hatari: kukata msitu kwenye miteremko, kufungua mashamba kwenye ardhi yenye mteremko mkali zaidi, kujenga kwenye kingo za vijito na kuvuka vivuko vilivyofurika kwa miguu au pikipiki. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au maji yakitiririka ya matope; tambarareni, fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia vijito vinapojaa, na subirini vivukoni badala ya kuvuka kwa miguu. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C029.name: Pangani District Council
C029.documented: Pangani mouth floods, large waves, strong winds, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Pangani: Pangani river mouth and coast
area.sw: Pangani: mdomo wa mto Pangani na pwani

risk.en: This area has a low town at the Pangani river mouth where river floods meet storm tides, the shore erodes and ferry crossings are exposed to rough water.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mji wa chini kwenye mdomo wa mto Pangani ambapo mafuriko ya mto hukutana na mawimbi makubwa, ufukwe humomonyoka na vivuko vya feri huathiriwa na maji machafu.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to build back from the shore and river banks, protect mangroves and use ferries only in safe conditions. What raises the risk: building on the eroding shore or the river mouth flats, cutting mangroves, mining sand from the beach and boarding an overloaded ferry or crossing when the river is in flood. Know the higher ground inland that your household will move to when a storm-tide warning is given or the Pangani rises, go before the water reaches the road, and wait on the bank rather than board when the crossing is rough. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na ufukwe na kingo za mto, kulinda mikoko na kutumia feri katika hali salama tu. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga kwenye ufukwe unaomomonyoka au tambarare za mdomo wa mto, kukata mikoko, kuchimba mchanga ufukweni na kupanda feri iliyojaa kupita kiasi au kuvuka mto ukiwa umefurika. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo kaya yako itahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba inapotolewa au Pangani inapojaa, ondokeni kabla maji hayajafika barabarani, na subirini ukingoni badala ya kupanda kivuko kikiwa hatarini. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
